purpose: Governed grant program, application, award and milestone lifecycle bound to Civic-authorized Treasury disbursements while 420Vault remains the custody/release authority.
integrations: 420 Wallet / ecosystem clients as replaceable presentation and transaction surfaces

requiredInitialization: deploy GrantAuthorization420 against the canonical CapabilityRegistry420
deploy GrantApplicationRegistry420 against GrantAuthorization420 and GrantProgramRegistry420
deploy GrantAwardRegistry420 against GovernanceTimelock, GrantProgramRegistry420 and GrantApplicationRegistry420
bind GrantProgramRegistry420.awardRegistry exactly once to the deployed GrantAwardRegistry420
deploy GrantMilestoneRegistry420 against GovernanceTimelock, GrantAuthorization420, GrantProgramRegistry420, GrantAwardRegistry420 and canonical TreasuryDisbursementRegistry420
deploy GrantRouter420 against GrantProgramRegistry420, GrantAwardRegistry420 and GrantMilestoneRegistry420
publish the qualified Grants service/component graph through the canonical Registry

invariants: GRANT-INV-001: grant programs bind to one Treasury budget and one Civic action commitment
GRANT-INV-002: program total cap and per-award cap are immutable for each program instance
GRANT-INV-003: GrantProgramRegistry420 is the single aggregate program-award accounting authority and accepts reservations only from the one-time-bound GrantAwardRegistry420
GRANT-INV-004: applications use canonical domain-separated IDs, are immutable after submission and reject exact replay
GRANT-INV-005: one application nonce may be consumed at most once per program and applicant, even if content changes
GRANT-INV-006: application submission is applicant-owned or narrowly capability-scoped and default-deny
GRANT-INV-007: awards can only target the applicant recorded by the accepted application
GRANT-INV-008: cumulative awards for one application cannot exceed that application's requested amount
GRANT-INV-009: inactive programs cannot create new awards and aggregate awards cannot exceed the program cap
GRANT-INV-010: aggregate non-cancelled milestone face value cannot exceed the award amount; cancelled milestone capacity is released without reusing its ordinal
GRANT-INV-011: each milestone ordinal is single-use per award
GRANT-INV-012: milestone claims are recipient-owned or narrowly capability-scoped and default-deny
GRANT-INV-013: milestone approval requires an ACTIVE parent award and an existing SCHEDULED Treasury disbursement with exact budget recipient amount Civic action and purpose matches
GRANT-INV-014: one Treasury disbursement may be bound to at most one grant milestone
GRANT-INV-015: an approved milestone may be cancelled only after its bound Treasury disbursement is canonically CANCELLED; Grants may never detach from a still-executable payment
GRANT-INV-016: a milestone is PAID only after the bound Treasury disbursement is EXECUTED with a nonzero Vault release commitment
GRANT-INV-017: an executed Treasury transfer cannot be hidden by cancelling its approved milestone; canonical payment evidence must be finalized as PAID
GRANT-INV-018: 420Grants never holds or transfers Treasury assets and cannot bypass Treasury caps or Vault custody
GRANT-INV-019: cancelling an unpaid grant object does not claw back already paid funds; recovery requires a separately authorized Treasury/Civic action
